D R I V E R ’ S S PA C E

travels. Available 8-way power driver’s seat. A digital instrument cluster with crisp displays of

open-air fun. At the center of it all – a steering wheel complete with Ford Bronco™ badging.

T R A V E L T H E T R A I L S I N C O M F O R T
With nods to the original Ford Bronco,™ the interior of the Ford Bronco Sport SUV provides a level of comfort to match
its off-road prowess. A driver’s footrest, available zipper pockets, and an available easy-clean cloth interior (not shown)
for all the mud and grime you’re bound to bring back with you, are all welcome highlights. As is the available B&O® Sound
System. They’re perfect for when you’re ready to settle in for a long road trip. And the Safari Style Roof provides ample
front and rear head room – enough, in fact, that with the available Yakima® dealer-installed interior bike rack, you can
stand two 27.5" wheel-mounted bikes upright when the rear seats are folded down.
